title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
summary: TechCrunch 报道 Drogue 已融资 2000 万美元，计划以海洋温差发电支持浮动数据中心，首个多兆瓦原型计划于 2028 年初出海。
investorNote: 电力与冷却一体化路径仍须证明海上工程和全生命周期成本。
displayTitle: Drogue 披露融资 2000 万美元，拟用海洋温差供电数据中心
narrative: TechCrunch 报道，初创公司 Drogue 已融资 2000 万美元，计划将海洋温差发电与浮动数据中心结合，并在 2028 年初部署多兆瓦原型。方案希望绕开陆上电网接入的部分等待，但目前仍是工程计划而非成熟供电能力；海况、维护、网络和单位电力成本能否支持长期运行，仍是关键约束。

fact.subject: Drogue
fact.action: 披露融资及海上数据中心计划
fact.object: 海洋温差发电和浮动数据中心

evidence.quote: Drogue was founded just six months ago in Washington, D.C., and the startup told TechCrunch exclusively that it has already raised $20 million
In those six months, Drogue has designed a multi-megawatt prototype that will be installed on a traditional oceangoing ship and sent out to sea in early 2028.
Drogue already has “approval in principle,” a preliminary sign-off, from the American Bureau of Shipping
